_comment: Pickable characters, shared by the Android app and the web build. Art is drop-in: put character_01.png (the number is the id) into app/src/main/res/drawable-nodpi/ and both builds find it. Until a character has art it draws as its colour with its initial. Ids are stable — renaming a character is safe, reordering is not, because the art filenames follow the id.
